Cc=1.5 pF and gm1≈235 µS give GBW≈25 MHz. gm7≈2 mS (200 µA) puts p2 well beyond GBW for PM>70°, and Rz>1/gm7 adds an LHP zero. A large-area input pair controls flicker noise. PARAMS = {
```python
    "gmid1": (14.0, 10.0, 18.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # input pair L (long: flicker noise, gain)
    "I1":    (17e-6, 8e-6, 40e-6),   # current per input device
    "Lp":    (0.8, 0.5, 2.0),        # PMOS load / output device L
    "gmidp": (10.0, 7.0, 14.0),      # PMOS load & output gm/Id (matched for low offset)
    "I7":    (200e-6, 100e-6, 350e-6),
    "Cc":    (1.5e-12, 0.6e-12, 3e-12),
    "kRz":   (1.6, 0.8, 4.0),        # Rz = kRz / gm7
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # NMOS current-source L
    "gmidn": (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),      # NMOS current-source gm/Id (headroom)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    I1 = p["I1"]; Itail = 2 * I1; I7 = p["I7"]; Cc = p["Cc"]

    # devices
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.5, vsb=0.2)        # input pair
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=0.8)                # mirror load
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I7, vds=0.9)                # output PMOS (same Vgs as load)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.6)              # ibias diode
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], Itail, vds=0.3)             # tail
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)                # output sink
    gm7 = m6.gm
    Rz = p["kRz"] / gm7

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    # vinn on diode side, vinp on output side -> non-inverting at vout
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "d2", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "d2", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "d2", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "d2", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # predictions
    gm1 = m1.gm
    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = gm7 / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m6.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    p2 = gm7 * Cc / (2 * PI * (C1 * Cc + C1 * cl + cl * Cc))
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd))
    den = Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / gm7)
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * den) if den > 0 else 1e15
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmir)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / z))
    power = (iref + Itail + I7 + 0.0) * 1.8
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    noise_th = math.sqrt(16 * kT / (3 * gm1) * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    noise = math.sqrt(noise_th**2 + (120e-9)**2)  # rough flicker allowance
    swing = 1.8 - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.2
    slew = min(Itail / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))
    settle = 0.5 / slew + 4.6 / (2 * PI * ugbw * 0.8)
    cmrr = db(2 * gm1 * a1 * m3.gm / max(m5.gds, 1e-12) / max(gm1, 1e-12) / 1.0) - 6
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "swing": swing, "slew": slew, "settle": settle, "noise_1k": noise,
               "psrr_db": gain_db - 25, "cmrr_db": min(cmrr, gain_db)}
```
